Title: Information on: What can I do to exterminate the rats in my attic?...
Exterminating rats from an attic typically involves a multi-step process. First, seal all entry points to prevent further infestation. Next, set up snap traps or glue boards near the entry points and food sources. Bait these traps with peanut butter or cheese. Lastly, use rodenticides as directed by a professional pest control service, ensuring safety for pets and children. Regularly check and replace traps until the infestation is eliminated. It's important to note that due to health and environmental concerns, it's recommended to hire a licensed pest control professional for effective and safe rat extermination.
--- End Document 1 ---
